name: joplin-direct-mcp
description: Direct Joplin Server MCP tools for scoped plaintext note workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Read and safely plan changes in Joplin Server.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex directly to a configured Joplin Server account over stdio MCP. The baseline supports online plaintext personal libraries, bounded reads, exact notebook scope and journaled preview/apply workflows.
